Edit the supplied 4-by-4 sprite sheet with exactly SIXTEEN full-body characters. This is cleanup of APPROVED artwork, not a redesign. Preserve each character's exact source pose, silhouette, anatomy, size, orientation, head design, material details and frame order. Preserve the existing four rows and four columns and the relative position of every character. Never combine, omit, add or reorder frames. Do not crop feet, heads or tails.
Preserve the lilac alien's eyes (including intentional blinks), fins, all paw and ear positions, pearl tail translucency, dark purple suit with pearl trim, expressions and exact 16-frame sequence.
Remove every cast ground shadow and gray shadow smear beneath/around every character. Retain the painted self-shading on the character and within its fur/armor so it does not look flat.
Replace only the white background and cast shadows with a completely flat pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0), including spaces between legs and around fur. No green cast or spill on the character. This green background is a temporary extraction matte, not part of the final sprite. Preserve clean fine fur edges and the original bright pale surfaces. No checkerboard texture, no gradients, no drop shadows, no text or labels. High-fidelity sprite cleanup at high resolution, preserving the original characters exactly. Output only the corrected sheet.
